preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' if m % 2 != 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the number of edges is odd, output 'No solution'.

postconditions.expression: len(paths) == m // 2 and all(len(set(path)) == 3 for path in paths)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the number of paths must be half the number of edges, and each path must consist of three distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(any(edge in path for path in paths) for edge in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge must be included in exactly one path.
